results.name: City bike model only Blender curves
results.displayName: City bike model only Blender curves
results.description: This is a meticulously crafted 3D model of a city bike, created using Blender 4.3.1. The model is designed exclusively with curves, resulting in a compact file size of approximately 8 megabytes. Despite omitting some minor details like screws, the bike maintains a high level of realism and is ideal for use as a background motif. The sleek blue frame, combined with black handlebars and saddle, gives it a modern and stylish appearance. The white sidewall tires and included fenders add to its urban aesthetic. Creating this model was a great exercise for me in handling Blender curves, and I highly recommend anyone wanting to master curves to try creating a complete model with them—you learn a lot. I hope you enjoy the model and may your scenes be successful.

results.name: Modern Abstract Bookshelves
results.description: This contemporary 3D asset is a sophisticated exercise in asymmetrical design, featuring a dual-tone finish with a cool gray exterior and a bright, reflective white interior. The front profile is uniquely divided into three distinct zones: two elegant arched apertures of varying heights that create a soft, organic feel, and one striking L-shaped shelf that breaks the symmetry with its sharp, right-angled geometry. This interplay between the curved voids and the rigid linear shelving provides a highly architectural look, catching the light differently within each recessed section. It is a perfect focal point for minimalist interior renders or modern art-gallery-style digital spaces.
